D/ CONSTANTINVS MAX AVG ; R/ GLORIA EXERCITVS

Copper alloy Roman nummus of Constantine I (306-337 AD), minted in Trier 332-333 AD. obv legend: CONSTANTINVS MAX AVG obv type: laureate, draped and cuirasses facing right. rev legend: GLORIA EXERCITVS rev type: two soldiers and two standards. Finder's number 7
